The table above shows the number of meals ordered from a restaurant on each day of the work week. What is the median number of meals ordered from Monday to Friday?
explanation: Choice B is correct. The median is the middle value when data is arranged in increasing order. Ordering the values gives $10, 12, 15, 18, 20$. With $5$ values, the middle value is $15$.
